scratchpad: The firm is facing a loss of 300 in profit. Option 1 results in a loss of 300 and grants 10 useless tokens. Option 2 cancels the loss of 300 in exchange for giving up 1 useless token. As the pricing manager acting in the best interests of Firm A and its shareholders, preventing a 300 profit loss is the only logical choice, especially since the tokens have no value.

The firm is facing a loss of 300 in profit. Option 1 allows the firm to avoid this loss by giving up 1 token. These tokens are described as having no use and being paid to no one. Therefore, the cost of giving up a token is zero in terms of monetary value or utility, while the benefit is saving 300 in profit for the firm and its shareholders. As the pricing manager acting in the best interests of the firm, I must choose the option that prevents the financial loss.
